name: Finanche
source:
A mage from the kingdom of Aria Zaza.

An apprentice to the sage who previously accompanied the Hero on his journey.
Having lost her parents at a young age, Finanche was raised by the sage in their stead. To Finanche, the sage is both her master and a parental figure.

In order to pay back the sage for having raised her, Finanche studied hard to become a skilled mage.
Because of this past, she blames the Hero for the death of the sage and looks down on him as lacking in ability.
